title: Proficiency
summary: Upon accumulation of Satisfaction, Proficiency Level will increase and special characteristics will be activated.

sections.note: Levels go up with the Satisfaction added up over all runs; every unlocked bonus stays on.

rows.sub: Reduces the time needed to prepare food.
Decreases the ratio of HP reduction.
Increases the moving speed of the maids.

rows.text: Increase Chance of Event Guest's Appearance
rows.sub: Increases the chance of event guests appearing.

rows: Switches to the busier event-customer schedule (see Customers)
